introHtml: Raglan baseball nursing scrubs offer a sporty, modern alternative to traditional V-neck styles. The raglan sleeve design provides greater range of motion, making them ideal for nurses who need to move freely throughout their shift. These scrubs also feature contrasting sleeve colors, which can be customized with your facility’s logo or department colors for a cohesive team look. Durable fabric blends ensure they hold up to frequent washing while maintaining a professional appearance.
